title: Funerary Stele of Aurelia Artemis
acquisition: Public rendered museum object page; inscription and metadata fields only. Longer description excluded.
text: Farewell Aurelia Artemis, Pasion’s daughter, incomparably sweetest among all.
transcription: Αὐρηλίαν Ἄρτεμειν θυγατέρα Πασίωνος τὴν γλυκυτάτην ἀσύνκριτον ἐν πᾶσι· εὐψύχι
provenance: Dikran Kelekian, New York and Paris, by purchase; Henry Walters, Baltimore, 1923, by purchase; Walters Art Museum, 1931, by bequest.
coverage_evidence: The museum supplies the Greek epitaph and its corresponding English rendering; the photograph shows the four-line epitaph below the figure. Egyptian geography, Greek language; no separate Mediterranean count.
visual_observation: 1800×1468 museum photograph: whole front, reclining figure and four lines of Greek visible; weathered stone and uneven lighting, lower text largely legible visually. No independent reading or alignment claimed.
rights_scope: Walters image and metadata CC0 policy. Longer descriptive text has separate GFDL terms and is not imported.
